7459.title: Selected skill hoisting removes an inline reference
7459.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude bridge unconditionally removes the selected skill token before hoisting its invocation, deleting a non-leading reference from the user's sentence.
7459.proposedFix: Retain the canonical skill name at a non-leading selection's original position while keeping the leading slash invocation. Preserve leading-only invocation and multiple-selection behavior.
7459.caveats: Reproduced twice through the real bridge and its SDK prompt boundary, not a live composer or vendor expansion. A local 68-line candidate passes all ten focused cases, but the provider suite has six failures on both pristine main and the candidate. The mandatory clean-suite condition failed, so no fix was committed, pushed, or proposed as a PR.
